The MPC89E58AP is an enhanced 8-bit 8051-compatible microcontroller from Megawin, designed for embedded control and general-purpose microcontroller applications. It combines a classic 80C51 CPU architecture with integrated Flash program memory, RAM, timers, UART, watchdog, ISP, and IAP capabilities.

The device operates from 4.5 V to 5.5 V and supports selectable 12T or 6T instruction modes, with operating frequencies up to 48 MHz in 12T mode or 24 MHz in 6T mode. The MPC89E58AP is supplied in a 44-pin PLCC package with additional I/O compared with the standard 40-pin 8051 package.

The PLCC-44 version provides 36 I/O pins, with the additional four Port 4 bits available specifically on the PLCC-44 and PQFP-44 versions.

The MPC89E58A family provides 32 KB of on-chip program Flash. A portion of the Flash can be configured for ISP programming space, with the remaining area available for IAP/data-Flash use. The datasheet describes configurable 1 KB, 2 KB, or 4 KB ISP memory, with up to 31 KB programmable data Flash depending on configuration.
The MCU includes three 16-bit timer/counters. Timer 2 additionally supports up/down counting and programmable clock output functionality.

The S9013 is a medium-power NPN transistor used for general purpose switching and amplification. It features a high transition frequency of 140MHz, making it suitable for high-frequency applications. It also has a relatively large collector current capacity of 500mA.

blocks.text: Operating and Storage Junction Temperature Range: -55 to +150 °C
Note: Complete technical details can be found in the S9013 datasheet linked at the end of this page.

The S9013 is a high current fast NPN transistor that can be used for general-purpose switching and amplification. It has a transition frequency of 140MHz. The transition frequency of a transistor is the frequency at which current gain drops to one, beyond which the transistor can no longer amplify signals. This limited bandwidth is due to internal parasitic capacitances.

The S9013 also has a high collector current rating of 500mA. However, at high currents, the gain drops off rapidly and a base current of up to 50mA is needed to achieve high collector currents. The power dissipation must also be taken into account. While the package is capable of dissipating 625mW, the thermal resistance of the TO-92 case limits the practical power dissipation. The thermal resistance is specified in degrees Celsius per watt. It specifies the rise in temperature for given power dissipation, and the junction temperature must never rise above 150˚C.

blocks.text: UNI-T UT705 Single Function Loop Calibrator

The UNI-T UT705 is a handheld, single-function loop calibrator designed for high-precision work in industrial instrumentation and control systems. Its primary role is to verify, calibrate, and troubleshoot 4-20 mA current loops, which are the standard signal type for transmitting sensor data in process automation. It serves as a reliable reference tool for technicians to ensure the accuracy of transmitters, controllers, and other loop-powered devices.

This device operates in two key modes: measurement and source/simulation. In measurement mode, it can accurately read DC voltage and, most importantly, the current in a live 4-20mA loop. A standout feature is its ability to simultaneously power a 2-wire transmitter and measure its output current, eliminating the need for an external power supply. In source mode, it generates a precise and stable DC current signal to simulate a transmitter’s output for testing receivers and control systems.

Built for efficiency in the field, the UT705 features an ergonomic design with a clear LCD display and a logical button layout for one-handed operation. It includes advanced automated functions like stepping and ramping, which automatically cycle the output signal to quickly test the linearity and response of a connected device. This combination of precision, functionality, and automated testing features makes it a dedicated tool for improving calibration workflow.
Measures DC voltage, DC current, and 4-20mA loop current.
Provides 24V loop power to a transmitter while simultaneously measuring its mA output current.
High accuracy of up to 0.02% for both measurement and output.
Automatic ramp and step output functions for fast linearity detection.
Ability to store and recall frequently-used settings.
Compact, handheld, and ergonomic design for easy portability.
Adjustable backlight brightness for various lighting conditions.

When putting a PIC in the ZIF (Zero Insertion Force) socket, the PIC Programming software will indicate how it should be positioned. Pin 1 on the ZIF socket is located next to the locking lever.
Run the "PL2303_Prolific_DriverInstaller_v1.7.0.exe" program in the "PIC Programmer Drivers" folder to install the driver.
Go to Start, and right click on "Computer". Click "Properties".
Click on the "Hardware" tab, and then click on "Device Manager".
Click the + next to "Ports (COM & LPT)". There should be an item labelled "Prolific USB-to-Serial Comm Port". There will be some text in brackets – such as "COM3". Make a note of the number.
Run the "microbrn.exe" file in the "PIC Programmer Software" folder.
It will usually fail to reset the programmer the first time it is started – the correct Serial port has not yet been selected. This is normal.
Click on the "File" menu, and choose "Programmer". Now choose "K150".
Click on the "File" menu, and choose "Port". Enter the value you noted down earlier and click OK.
The programming software should now reset your programmer and you are ready to go!

Please note that on Windows 7, the "Reset Programmer" option on the "Programmer" menu may not function correctly. All other functions work as expected. This is due to an issue between the Prolific USB to Serial drivers and the Microbrn software on Windows 7. This option works OK on older operating systems such as Windows XP.

The UC1842/3/4/5 family of control devices provides the necessary features to implement off-line or dc-to-dc fixed frequency current mode control schemes with a minimal external parts count. Internally implemented circuits include under-voltage lockout featuring start up current less than 1 mA, a precision reference trimmed for accuracy at the error amp input, logic to insure latched operation, a PWM comparator which also provides current limit control, and a totem pole output stage designed to source or sink high peak current. The output stage, suitable for driving N-Channel MOSFETs, is low in the off state.

Differences between members of this family are the under-voltage lockout thresholds and maximum duty cycle ranges. The UC1842 and UC1844 have UVLO thresholds of 16 VON and 10 VOFF, ideally suited to off-line applications. The corresponding thresholds for the UC1843 and UC1845 are 8.4 V and 7.6 V. The UC1842 and UC1843 can operate to duty cycles approaching 100%. A range of zero to 50% is obtained by the UC1844 and UC1845 by the addition of an internal toggle flip flop which blanks the output off every other clock cycle.Datasheet

The FT232R is the latest device to be added to FTDI’s range of USB UART interface Integrated Circuit Devices. The FT232R is a USB to serial UART interface with optional clock generator output, and the new FTDIChip-ID™ security dongle feature. In addition, asynchronous and synchronous bit bang interface modes are available. USB to serial designs using the FT232R have been further simplified by fully integrating the external EEPROM, clock circuit and USB resistors onto the device.

The FT232R adds two new functions compared with its predecessors, effectively making it a "3-in-1" chip for some application areas. The internally generated clock (6MHz, 12MHz, 24MHz, and 48MHz) can be brought out of the device and used to drive a microcontroller or external logic. A unique number (the FTDIChip-ID™) is burnt into the device during manufacture and is readable over USB, thus forming the basis of a security dongle which can be used to protect customer application software from being copied.
The FT232R is available in Pb-free (RoHS compliant) compact 28-Lead SSOP and QFN-32 packages.

blocks.text: SAB8287AP Octal Bus Transceiver 5V 90mA IC DIP-20

The SAB8287A is an 8-bit bipolar bus transceiver that provides bidirectional data transfer and bus buffering with three-state outputs and dedicated control inputs for direction and output enable. It is the inverting member of the SAB8286/SAB8287 family, so inputs on the A-side are presented inverted on the B-side (useful where logic inversion is required between subsystems). Direction is controlled by the T (TRANSMIT) input and outputs are gated by the active-LOW OE (OUTPUT ENABLE) control, allowing easy interfacing to microprocessor and system buses.

Designed for 5 V systems, the device offers robust output drive for system-level loads and supports a high-impedance (three-state) mode to allow multiple devices to share the bus without output low-glitches when entering/leaving the high-Z state. It was commonly used as a data bus buffer/driver in systems based on SAB8086/SAB80286 families and other microcomputer architectures that require reliable, bidirectional 8-bit bus interfacing.

blocks.text: KA3842 Current-Mode PWM Controller IC DIP-8

The KA3842 is a high-performance current-mode PWM controller IC designed for off-line and DC-DC converter applications that require high efficiency, precision control, and fast response. It operates as a fixed-frequency controller and provides all the essential functions needed for implementing reliable and cost-effective switch-mode power supplies (SMPS). With a wide operating voltage range of 7.6 V to 30 V and a precision 5.0 V reference, the KA3842 delivers stable operation across a variety of input conditions.

Featuring a high-speed totem-pole output, the KA3842 can directly drive power MOSFETs or BJTs with peak currents up to 1 A, ensuring efficient switching and reduced power losses. Its current-mode control architecture provides superior line and load regulation, automatic pulse-by-pulse current limiting, and inherent cycle-by-cycle overcurrent protection.

The KA3842 includes undervoltage lockout (UVLO) with typical start and stop thresholds of 16 V and 10 V, making it particularly well suited for off-line (AC-to-DC) power supplies and continuous conduction mode designs. Housed in a compact DIP-8 package, it offers a cost-effective solution for applications such as industrial power supplies, motor drivers, and battery chargers that demand robust, efficient PWM control.

blocks.text: The RS-CO-V05-2-2000P-2 sensor is a fixed carbon monoxide gas detector that outputs a 0–5 V analog signal corresponding to CO concentration. Its enclosure is designed for stable, continuous mounting in indoor or semi-industrial settings. The sensor is meant for permanent installation in areas where carbon monoxide accumulation must be monitored, such as utility rooms, plant areas, or enclosed spaces.

Gas molecules enter the sensor via a diffusion port or membrane and reach the internal sensing element (typically electrochemical). The interaction of CO with the sensing electrode causes a proportional change in voltage (or current, internally), which is conditioned and converted to a voltage output in the span 0 to 5 V. The internal signal processing typically includes compensation for ambient temperature and humidity variations to improve accuracy and stability.

Over time, the RS-CO-V05-2-2000P-2 maintains stability via low drift electronics and self-diagnostic capability (in some implementations). It interfaces directly with control systems, alarms, or data acquisition units that accept 0–5 V analog inputs. In safety systems, it can trigger alerts or ventilation when CO levels rise above pre-set thresholds. Its construction aims to minimize maintenance and provide reliable performance over long durations.

blocks.text: Signal Relay SPDT BSZ5-SS-112L (1 Form C) 12VDC Coil 1A Through Hole 5 Pin

The Signal Relay BSZ5-SS-112L is a compact, PCB-mount SPDT (1 Form C) signal relay engineered for low-power switching in tightly packed electronic assemblies. Housed in a plastic-sealed body, it combines a small footprint (≈15.5 × 10.6 × 11.5 mm) with reliable contact performance up to 1 A, making it suitable where board density and dependable switching are required. The relay’s coil is driven by 12 VDC in the specified variant, providing predictable electromagnetic actuation while keeping coil power consumption low.

Mechanically robust for its class, the BSZ5 features plated through-hole pins for secure soldered connections and a plastic insulation material selected for high temperature and chemical resistance. Contacts are made from an Ag-alloy to balance low contact resistance and durability. The sealed construction excludes dust and solder flux, helping maintain contact integrity over many cycles even in typical household-appliance environments.

Electrically the relay offers quick response (operate time ≤10 ms, release ≤5 ms) and strong dielectric isolation (1,000 VAC between coil and contacts). It endures mechanical and electrical stress with rated life expectancies (electrical ≈10⁵ ops at rated resistive load; mechanical ≈10⁷ ops no load) and is designed to withstand surges (1,500 V) and wide operating conditions (−30 to 70 °C, 5–85% RH). These characteristics combine to deliver consistent, long-term switching in appliances and control systems.
Small size (15.5×10.6×11.5 in mm) produces a switching capacity up to 1A for high density PCB mounting technique.

The ESP32 at the heart of the package has a Tensilica Xtensa dual-core 32-bit LX6 microprocessor, with 448KB of ROM and 520KB of SRAM (including 8KB of RTC memory), and a 1KB eFuse. The SIP module integrates 4MB of SPI Flash memory, although as the ESP32 can support up to 16MB it’s possible we might see that in future revisions. Wireless connectivity support is 802.11 b/g/n/e/i (802.11n up to 150 Mbps), alongside Bluetooth V4.2 (BR/EDR and Bluetooth LE support).

The module interfaces include an SD card, UART, SPI, SDIO, LED PWM, Motor PWM, I2S, I2C, IR, as well as GPIO, capacitive touch sensor, ADC, DAC, and an LNA pre-amplifier. The chip also has two onboard sensors—a Hall sensor to detect magnetic fields, and a temperature sensor. Its small footprint and reduced number of external components make it perfectly suited for wearables and other Internet of Things devices.

TC4528BP/BF contains two circuits of monostable multivibrators with the capabilities of retrigger operation and reset operation in one chip. The trigger operation can be achieved either by rising edge or falling edge if one of two inputs A and Bar selected. As the pulse width of mono-stable multi- vibrator output is determined by the time constant of external resistor (Rx) and external capacitor (Cx), wide range of output pulse width can be obtained. The asynchronous reset operation from outside can be achieved by setting CD input to “L” level, and this CD input can be also applied for inhibiting the trigger operation and for shortening the time period from turning the power on the time when TC4528B becomes able to perform the mono-stable operation.

The BC559 transistor is a general-purpose PNP transistor. This transistor also comes with many different versions, if you are using this transistor as an amplifier make sure you check the gain of the transistor from the datasheet that can be found below. The Collector−Emitter Voltage(VCEO) of this device is -30V, the Collector−Base Voltage(VCBO) is -30V, and the Emitter−Base Voltage(VEBO) is -5V. Moreover, this device has a continuous collector current of -100Madc and can operate with 150°C. Additionally, the gain-bandwidth product of this transistor is very high so it can be used in many high-frequency applications.

When this transistor is in a biased condition, it can allow a maximum current of -100mA across CE(Collector-Emitter) Junction, this state of the transistor is called the saturation state, and driving a load that consumes more current than -100mA may damage the device in this condition. As you already may know, a transistor is a current-controlled device so when the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, in this stage the transistor is working in its Cut-off Region and the Base Emitter voltage could be around -660 mV.

The BC559 transistor is a general-purpose PNP transistor. A PNP transistor is made up of a doped N-Type material that is sanduzied in between two P-Type materials. In a PNP transistor hole are the majority charge carrier that means the holes are emitted by the collector which is collected by the emitter, the main difference between the NPN and PNP transistor is that in an NPN transistor the flow of electrons is from collector to emitter, but in a PNP transistor the electrons run from emitter to collector, as a result, a PNP transistor turns on when there is a low or 0V on the base of the transistor. Whereas, an NPN transistor is on when a positive or high signal is applied.

Transistors are current-controlled devices so to turn them on/off a little current is needed. For the BC556 Transistor, this current is less than 2mA, as BC556 is a PNP transistor that means it will be on when the base is connected to the ground, and it will be off when a positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor.

makers-321850.summary: The PBS-11B 12mm Momentary Push Button Switch is a compact round panel-mount switch designed for temporary ON control in electronic circuits and control panels. This model is also commonly supplied under equivalent market names such as PB-305B and PBS-305B .

blocks.text: 12mm 2-Pin Momentary Round Plastic Push Button Switch

The 12mm 2-Pin Momentary Round Plastic Push Button Switch is a compact and easy-to-install panel-mount push button designed for applications that require temporary switching action. This means the switch turns ON only while the button is being pressed and automatically returns to OFF when the button is released.

This product is commonly supplied or listed under several equivalent market model names, including PBS-11B, PB-305B, and PBS-305B. These names are often used by different suppliers for the same general type of 12mm round plastic momentary push button switch. The key identifier is the letter B, which normally refers to the momentary or non-locking version.

The PBS-11B is suitable for many control and signal applications where a maintained ON state is not required. It can be used as a reset button, trigger button, test button, doorbell-style control, relay activation button, or input button for electronic circuits. Its 2-pin layout allows quick wiring, and its threaded body with fixing nut allows secure installation into control boxes, panels, and project enclosures.

The switch has a round plastic button head, compact body, metal contacts, and a simple mechanical return action. When pressed, the internal contacts close the circuit. When the button is released, the contacts open again. This makes it different from the PBS-11A version, which stays locked after pressing.

The switch is available in multiple colors, allowing clear identification inside a control panel. Red may be used for stop or alarm functions, green for start or enable functions, yellow for warning or auxiliary functions, blue for special control circuits, and black for general-purpose operation. Color function depends on the design of the panel or project.

Although the switch body may be marked with a rating such as 3A 250V AC, it is recommended to use this compact push button in low-current control circuits or as a signal input. مفتاح الضغط الدائري مقاس 12 مللي بطرفين هو مفتاح لحظي صغير الحجم مخصص للاستخدام في الدوائر التي تحتاج إلى تشغيل مؤقت فقط أثناء الضغط على الزر. عند الضغط على المفتاح يتم توصيل الدائرة، وعند رفع اليد يعود المفتاح تلقائيًا إلى وضع الفصل.

هذا المنتج قد يتوفر في السوق بأكثر من اسم موديل، مثل PBS-11B أو PB-305B أو PBS-305B. هذه الأسماء غالبًا تشير إلى نفس النوع العام من مفاتيح الضغط الدائرية البلاستيك مقاس 12 مللي، لكن النقطة الأهم هي حرف B لأنه يشير عادةً إلى النسخة اللحظية غير ذاتية التثبيت.

يستخدم هذا المفتاح في التطبيقات التي لا تحتاج إلى بقاء الدائرة في وضع التشغيل بعد الضغط. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا كزر إعادة تشغيل، زر اختبار، زر جرس، زر تفعيل ريلاي، زر إشارة، أو زر إدخال في الدوائر الإلكترونية. تصميمه بطرفين فقط يجعل توصيله سهلًا وسريعًا، كما أن جسمه المزود بقلاوظ وصامولة تثبيت يسمح بتركيبه بسهولة داخل العلب ولوحات التحكم.

عند الضغط على الزر يتم غلق نقاط التلامس الداخلية، وعند ترك الزر تفتح النقاط مرة أخرى. وهذا هو الفرق الأساسي بينه وبين نسخة PBS-11A التي تظل في وضع التشغيل بعد الضغط عليها حتى يتم الضغط مرة أخرى للفصل.

يتوفر المفتاح بعدة ألوان لتسهيل تنظيم لوحات التحكم. يمكن استخدام اللون الأحمر لوظائف الإيقاف أو التنبيه، الأخضر للتشغيل، الأصفر للتنبيه أو الوظائف المساعدة، الأزرق لوظائف خاصة، والأسود للاستخدام العام، حسب تصميم اللوحة أو المشروع.

رغم أن المفتاح قد يكون مكتوبًا عليه تصنيف 3 أمبير و250 فولت، يفضل استخدامه في دوائر التحكم منخفضة التيار أو كإشارة تشغيل لريلاي أو دائرة إلكترونية. في حالة الأحمال الكبيرة أو المحركات أو السخانات أو الأحمال التي تسحب تيارًا عاليًا عند بدء التشغيل، الأفضل استخدام المفتاح للتحكم في ريلاي أو كونتاكتور بدلًا من توصيل الحمل مباشرة عليه.

blocks.text: Transistors are current-controlled devices so to turn them on a little current is needed. For the BD140 Transistor, this base current is less than 10mA, as BD140 is a PNP transistor that means it will be on when the base is connected to the ground, and it will be off when a positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor.
The simulated circuit below shows how this transistor behaves when the base of the basic circuit is connected to the ground and when it’s connected to 12V of the power supply.

When we turn on the transistor by connecting the base to the ground the transistor will remain on unless the voltage at the base of the transistor reaches more than the base turn-off voltage, for this transistor, it is somewhere in between 0.7 -0.9V. The base of the transistor cannot be left floating otherwise there could be false triggering, which may lead to issues in the circuit. To resolve this issue, we need to add pullup resistors as shown in the example, a 10K resistor is used to pull up the base of the transistor to VCC.

A Relay is a digital switch to control much higher voltages and currents than your normal Arduino boards does. When inputs a logic voltage, the relay will switch to allow current to flow or cutoff, depending on your wiring. A Relay usually consists of a coil, 1 common terminal, 1 normally closed terminal and one normally open terminal. When the coil is energized, the common terminal and the normally open terminal will have continuity.

Why do we want to use a relay and do we really need to? Anytime you want to switch on/off a device which draws more current or works with a high voltage, you’ll need to use a relay, such as controlling of headlights, parking lights, horns, etc.

The PIC16F688 microcontroller has a built-in 10-bit ADC with eight input channels. The eight channels are available at RA0, RA1, RA2, RA4, RC0, RC1, RC2, and RC3. They have alternate labels, AN0-AN7, for this function, and are multiplexed into a single sample and Hold circuit. The?output of the sample and hold is?connected to the input of the A/D converter. The A/D conversion is successive approximation based and the 10-bit result is stored??into the ADC result registers ADRESH (A/D Result Higher byte) and ADRESL (A/D Result Lower byte). Each of these registers is 8-bit.
Pin diagram of the PIC16F688 microcontroller
The functionality of the A/D module is controlled by three registers: ANSEL, ADCON0, and ADCON1.

The ANSEL register is used to configure the input mode of an I/O pin to analog. Setting the appropriate ANSEL bit High will cause all digital reads on the pin to be read as 0, and allow analog function on the pin to operate correctly. The state of ANSEL bits has no effect on digital O/P function. A pin with TRIS bit clear and ANSEL bit set will operate as digital O/P but the input mode will be analog.

The ADCON0 register selects which analog input is to be measured. This is required, since there are several channels for?analog input but only one A/D converter circuitry.?The channel select bits CHS0-CHS2 of ADCON0 register controls which analog channel is connected to the internal Sample and Hold circuit. For example, if you want to measure input analog voltage at AN2 (RA2) pin, you should set CHS1, and clear CHS0 and CHS2. The reference voltage used in the A/D conversion process is software selectable to either Vdd or a voltage applied to the Vref pin (12). This is controlled by VCFG bit of ADCON0 register. If VCFG is set, the reference voltage for the A/D conversion will be the voltage applied at the Vref pin. Bit 0 (ADON) of ADCON0 is the On/Off switch for the A/D converter. When it is set, the ADC is On, and the PIC microcontroller consumes extra current. GO/DONE bit of ADCON0 is set to start an A/D conversion cycle. It is automatically cleared by hardware when the conversion is done. This bit can, therefore, be tested to see if the A/D conversion is completed or in progress.

As mentioned earlier, the 10-bit digital output is held over two registers, ADRESH and ADRESL. You have a choice in how you want the 10-bit number stored into the two 8-bit registers. It can be right-justified by setting ADFM bit of ADCON0 so that bits 0:7 of the 10-bit result are held in ADRESL and bits 8:9 are stored in bits 0:1 of ADRESH. Similarly, clearing the ADFM bit shift the 10-bit output to the left. This is illustrated below.
Shifting the ADC result left or right with ADFM bit

The ADCON1 register also plays an important role in programming the A/D module.?An ADC requires a clock source to operate. ADCS (A/D conversion Clock Select) bits of ADCON1 register are the selection bits for the A/D conversion clock. The conversion time per bit is defined as TAD?in PIC documentation from Microchip.?The A/D conversion cycle requires 11 TAD.?For correct conversion, the A/D conversion clock?(1/TAD) must be selected to ensure a minimum TAD?of?1.6 ?s. In PIC16F688, there are?seven possible clock options for A/D conversion that are software selected, as shown below.
Software selectable clock sources for A/D conversion

The input of the ADC has a sample and hold circuit, to ensure that the voltage?sampled is constant during the conversion process. This contains a holding capacitor that stores the sampled input voltage.?Acquisition time is the amount time required to charge the holding capacitor on the

front end of an analog-to-digital converter. The holding capacitor must be given?sufficient time to settle to the analog input voltage level before the actual?conversion is initiated, otherwise?the?conversion will be inaccurate. The source impedance of the input voltage and the impedance of the internal sampling switch are the two major factors to determine the required acquisition time. An increase in the source impedance?will increase the required acquisition time. Therefore, the maximum recommended source impedance for analog sources is 10K. ?A typical value of acquisition time is 20 ?s.
Programming the A/D module consists of the following steps:
1. Configure the analog/digital I/O using ANSEL register. All analog lines are initialized
as input in the corresponding TRIS registers.
2. Select the A/D input channel by setting the CHSx bits in the ADCON0?register. Also, select right- or left-justification (ADFM bit), and the reference voltage (VCFG bit).
3. Select the A/D conversion clock (ADCS bits), and enable the A/D module (ADON bit).
5. Initiate the conversion by setting the GO/DONE bit in the ADCON0 register.
6. Wait for the conversion to complete.
7. Read and store the digital result.
A minimum wait of 2 TAD?is?required before the next acquisition starts.

The ESP-32D Module is a compact ESP32 wireless SMD module designed for embedded systems, IoT devices, wireless control applications and custom PCB designs. It combines a dual-core 32-bit MCU with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity in a compact module with an integrated PCB antenna.

The module integrates the main RF and wireless functions required for ESP32 applications, helping reduce external component count and PCB area while providing flexible GPIO connectivity for sensors, controllers and communication interfaces.
Suitable for direct integration into custom PCBs.
Designed for low-power embedded and IoT applications.
Integrated RF transmit/receive circuitry and power management.

The ESP-32D integrates 2.4GHz WLAN and Bluetooth connectivity in a single module. Its built-in RF section includes the antenna interface, RF switching, power amplifier, low-noise receive amplifier, filtering and power-management functions required for wireless operation.
The ESP32 architecture supports several power-saving techniques for battery-powered and energy-sensitive applications, including clock gating, multiple low-power modes and dynamic voltage scaling.
These features allow the module to remain in a reduced-power state and wake only when required by the application, making it suitable for wireless sensors and other low-duty-cycle IoT systems.
The module exposes a wide range of ESP32 signals and GPIO pins for connection to external electronics.
PWM and other ESP32 peripheral functions.

This product is an SMD ESP32 module intended to be soldered directly onto a compatible PCB. It is not a complete USB development board and requires the appropriate external circuitry, power supply and programming connection in the final design.

blocks.text: WagoLT-223-3 Panel Mount Wire Connector 3 In 3 Out – Spring Clamp Cable Terminal
Wago LT-223-3 Panel Mount Wire Connector 3 In 3 Out

The Wago LT-223-3 Panel Mount Wire Connector is a practical and efficient wiring solution designed for users who need secure and organized cable connections inside electrical panels, control boxes, and compact wiring systems. With its 3 input and 3 output configuration, it allows easy parallel connection of multiple conductors while keeping the wiring layout neat and space-saving.

This connector is built with a spring clamp connection mechanism, which makes installation faster and easier compared to traditional screw terminals. Wires can be inserted and held securely without twisting or soldering, reducing installation time and making rewiring more convenient when maintenance or modifications are needed. The spring-based contact design also helps maintain stable electrical performance over time.

Its panel mount structure makes it ideal for applications where the connector needs to stay fixed in place for a more professional and reliable wiring setup. This makes it suitable for electrical panels, automation cabinets, lighting systems, control equipment, and organized distribution wiring inside compact enclosures.

The housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate, providing both durability and improved safety during daily use. The internal conductive parts are made from tin-plated copper alloy, supporting good conductivity and dependable contact performance. The connector is also reusable, which adds convenience for repeated service and installation work.

With its compact design, practical connection method, and reliable mounting style, the LT-223-3 is a useful choice for electricians, technicians, installers, panel builders, maintenance users, and workshop applications that require fast and secure multi-wire connections.

blocks.text: Arduino Uno R3 SMD CH340G ATmega328p Development Board Compatible Without Cable
Arduino Uno R3 CH340G Development Board
The Uno R3 CH340G ATmega328p Development Board is the low-cost version of the popular Uno R3 Arduino. It is assembled with the CH340 USB to Serial converter chip, instead of using an Atmega16U2 chip.

We have used plenty of these low-cost Arduino boards with CH340 chips, and have found them to work perfectly. The only time the CH340 chip is used is during programming and when using the serial output of the USB port. During normal operation, this board is identical to the more expensive version without CH340 chip.
Main changes from the older version Arduino uno R3 ch340
1. Two rows of the holes for the pins (Male and Female). So it can be connected with normal Female Jumpers.
2. Additional 3 rows of the holes for wiring.
3. Changes to the DIP package of ATMEGA328P to flat package.
3. Plug in UNO development board, the driver will be installed automatically
4. Select the UNO from the die
6. The best choice first, Arduino comes with routine procedures, burn into it.

blocks.text: 0.08mm High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire 100M

0.08mm High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire 100M is a fine, durable cutting wire supplied on a compact reel for precision mobile phone repair, screen separation, adhesive cutting, display refurbishing, and delicate maintenance work. The wire is designed with high toughness and anti-pull properties, making it suitable for controlled cutting through adhesive layers where ordinary weak wire may break easily.

This soft tungsten alloy wire is commonly used by mobile repair technicians for separating screens, cutting glue layers, removing adhesive between display assemblies, and performing controlled fine cutting tasks during phone and electronics repair. With a very thin 0.08mm diameter, it can pass through narrow adhesive gaps while helping reduce the risk of applying excessive mechanical force to the part being repaired.

The supplied spool is marked as High Toughness Soft Tungsten Alloy Wire, with the 0.08mm size selected and 100M length selected on the label. This makes it a practical workshop consumable for repeated repair jobs. The thin profile is useful when working with delicate screens, touch panels, display frames, back covers, adhesive layers, and other tight areas that require a fine cutting line.

The wire label highlights Anti-pull and High toughness, which are important characteristics for repair work because the wire needs to stay consistent while being pulled through adhesive. In mobile repair, wire stability helps the technician keep better control during separation and reduces interruptions caused by frequent wire snapping.

The reel is packed inside a sealed protective plastic package to help keep the wire clean and organised before use. This is useful for workshops because fine wire can easily become tangled if stored loosely. The reel format allows the user to pull out the needed length, cut it, and keep the remaining wire protected for future use.

This product is not an electronic component and does not require power. It is a mechanical consumable tool used together with proper repair technique, screen separator machines, heating plates, glue cutting handles, or manual separation tools depending on the repair job. For best results, adhesive should usually be softened with controlled heat before using the wire, especially with phone screens and back covers.

سلك تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة ٠٫٠٨ مم طول ١٠٠ متر لفصل الشاشات

سلك تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة ٠٫٠٨ مم طول ١٠٠ متر هو سلك رفيع مخصص لأعمال صيانة الهواتف وفصل الشاشات وقطع طبقات اللاصق بدقة. يأتي السلك على بكرة داخل تغليف واقي، وهو مناسب لفنيين الصيانة الذين يحتاجون إلى سلك رفيع يتحمل الشد أثناء فصل الشاشة أو الغطاء الخلفي أو إزالة اللاصق من الأماكن الضيقة.

هذا السلك يُستخدم كأداة مساعدة في صيانة الهواتف المحمولة، خصوصًا عند فصل الشاشات أو تمرير السلك بين طبقات اللاصق بعد التسخين المناسب. قطر السلك الرفيع ٠٫٠٨ مم يجعله مناسبًا للدخول في المسافات الضيقة بين الشاشة والفريم أو بين الغطاء الخلفي والجسم، مما يساعد الفني على تنفيذ عملية الفصل بطريقة أكثر تحكمًا من استخدام أدوات سميكة أو ضغط زائد.

الملصق الموجود على البكرة يوضح أن السلك من نوع تنجستن مرن عالي المتانة، كما يظهر اختيار مقاس ٠٫٠٨ مم واختيار طول ١٠٠ متر. هذا الطول مناسب للاستخدام المتكرر داخل الورشة، حيث يمكن للفني قص الجزء المطلوب لكل عملية والاحتفاظ بباقي السلك منظمًا داخل البكرة.

الميزة المهمة في هذا النوع من الأسلاك أنه يجمع بين الرفع والمتانة. في أعمال فصل الشاشات، السلك يحتاج إلى تحمل الشد أثناء المرور داخل طبقة اللاصق بدون أن ينقطع بسرعة. كما أن الرفع يساعد في تقليل الاحتكاك الزائد والدخول في الفواصل الضيقة، بشرط استخدامه بطريقة صحيحة ومع تسخين مناسب عند الحاجة.

وجود السلك داخل بكرة محمية بتغليف بلاستيك يساعد في الحفاظ عليه من الاتساخ والتشابك. الأسلاك الرفيعة قد تتلف أو تتعقد بسهولة إذا تم تخزينها بشكل عشوائي، لذلك وجود بكرة مخصصة يجعل المنتج مناسبًا للاستخدام اليومي في مراكز الصيانة ومحلات إصلاح الهواتف.

يُنصح باستخدام هذا السلك مع أدوات مناسبة مثل مقابض شد السلك أو أدوات فصل الشاشة أو ماكينة التسخين أو سخان هواء مضبوط حسب نوع عملية الصيانة. السلك نفسه لا يحتاج إلى كهرباء، ولكنه يحتاج إلى خبرة وتحكم أثناء السحب لتجنب قطع الفلاتات أو خدش أجزاء حساسة داخل الجهاز.

blocks.text: SUNSHINE SS-905D IP/Android Smart Power Cable (V100) – 3-Pin Boot Line

The SUNSHINE SS-905D Smart Power Cable is a professional 3-pin boot line that lets you power-on and troubleshoot iPhone and Android mainboards safely from a bench power supply. With auto-identify polarity, auto-matching battery protocol, and over-voltage protection, the SS-905D gives technicians a repeatable, damage-free way to read idle/boot current, verify short circuits, and perform software or baseband repairs without installing a physical battery. The V100 generation adopts a sustainable expansion design (module + detachable leads) and a compact controller (≈63×35 mm) with flexible PVC leads and thick pure-copper cores for stable current delivery.
✅ 3-wire, damage-free boot: B+, B-, and S (data/NTC) simulate a real battery to avoid false boots and protect PMIC/CPU.
🔌 Apple & Android coverage: dedicated battery contact holders for mainstream iPhone generations and multi-brand Android pads—no alligator clips needed.
🧠 Intelligent protections: reverse-polarity, over-voltage, and zero burn-in prevention when the PSU is mis-set or sense pin is floating.
🔄 Auto-match battery protocol: identifies the battery agreement and auto-detects positive/negative for quick startup.
🧰 1:1 precision fit: molded bases align with board pads for a secure connection that won’t lift pads or slip during probing.
🧵 Workshop-friendly build: ≈425 mm supply lead; ≈380 mm per device lead; soft PVC insulation; pure-copper conductor for low loss.
🔧 Expandable architecture: controller accepts swappable leads—keep the core and add future cable sets as models evolve.
⏱️ Faster diagnostics: instant boot lets you read standby/boot/idle current to isolate shorts, leakage, or sensor faults.

🧪 Software service: keep the board powered during update/restore when a test battery isn’t available.
🛡️ Data recovery: safe temporary power to dump NAND or check peripherals.
🧭 School/bench training: consistent demonstration of normal vs. faulty current curves.
🧠 Smart protections: reverse connection lockout; over-voltage guard; controller prevents instant burn when sense pin is wrong.

microohm-2169.summary: Dual Led 0.28 inch DC 100V 100A LED Digital Ammeter-Voltmeter With Shunt

blocks.text: Dual Led 0.28 inch DC 100V 100A LED Digital Ammeter-Voltmeter With Shunt
Dual Led 0.28 ” Display for DC0-100V 100A Voltage and Current Test Digital Instrument, Digital Meter Panel Amplifier Red Blue 100A
This is 0.28″ 5 Wires Red Led Digital Dual DC 100V 100A Ammeter Voltmeter. This meter will measure up to 100 VDC with a 0.1-volt resolution.

One thing to note is, this meter has 2 wiring harnesses. One harness is to provide power for the meters, that’s the 2 poles with a RED and a BLACK lead. Small size, portable, the magnitudes of voltage and current are displayed on the same screen at the same time.

This can be supplied anywhere from 6 volts DC up to 30 VDC. This is a separate power supply that is isolated from the source, it is possible to use the same supply but it seems to affect the amp meter reading. The 3 wire harness is used for a ground that connects directly to the battery or supply ground of the load.

Note: There are two different wiring variants (i.e. yellow wire and Green wire ) with the same working functionality is available which will be shipped randomly. Use the following guidelines according to your version.
CASE 1: Onboard Wiring Instructions for “Yellow” Wire connection
1. Thin Red Wire (VCC): positive pole of power supply input (4.5-30V)
(Note: if the measuring signal is less than 30V and the power is adequate, can be the power supply of module)
2. Thin Black Wire (GND): the negative pole of power supply input (4.5-30V, common ground with measuring signal)
3. Green Wire (VIN): positive pole of measuring signal input (0-100V)
4. Thick Red Wire (I ): positive pole of current input (series connect on the power supply cathode)
5. Thick Black Wire (I-): the negative pole of current input (series connect on the power supply cathode)
Note: If the input voltage is more than 5V, then, please use a buck converter.
Note: This Product Does Not include a shunt.
CASE 2: Onboard Wiring Instructions for “Green” Wire connection
(The current range of 10A requires the external shunt connection process)

blocks.text: Arduino Due AT91SAM3X8E ARM Cortex-M3 Board, 84MHz, 512KB Board compatible with Arduino

The Due is a microcontroller board based on the Atmel SAM3X8E ARM Cortex-M3 CPU. The Due Arduino AT91SAM3X8E ARM Cortex-M3 Board is the first Arduino board based on a 32-bit ARM core microcontroller. It has 54 digital input / output pins (of which 12 can be used as PWM outputs), 12 analog inputs, 4 UARTs (hardware serial ports), a 84 MHz clock, an USB OTG capable connection, 2 DAC (digital to analog), 2 TWI, a power jack, an SPI header, a JTAG header, a reset button and an erase button.

The board contains everything needed to support the microcontroller; simply connect it to a computer with a micro-USB cable or power it with an AC-to-DC adapter or battery to get started. The Due is compatible with all Arduino shields that work at 3.3V and are compliant with the 1.0 Arduino pinout.

The SAM3X has 512KB (2 blocks of 256KB) of flash memory for storing code. The bootloader is pre-burned in a factory from Atmel and is stored in a dedicated ROM memory. The available SRAM is 96KB in two contiguous banks of 64KB and 32KB. All the available memory (Flash, RAM, and ROM) can be accessed directly as a flat addressing space.

It is possible to erase the Flash memory of the SAM3X with the onboard erase button. This will remove the currently loaded sketch from the MCU. To erase, press and hold the Erase button for a few seconds while the board is powered.
TWI: SDA and SCL pins that are near to the AREF pin.

Note: Unlike other Arduino boards, the Due board runs at 3.3V. The maximum voltage that the I/O pins can tolerate is 3.3V. Providing higher voltages, like 5V to an I/O pin could damage the board.

blocks.text: TL072 is a dual operational amplifier IC with many good features, in this article we are going to discuss about TL072 pinout, features, applications, and other useful information about this audio IC.
Low noise and low distortion circuitry
Short circuit protection at the output
Dual operational amplifiers in a single package

TL072 is a very popular operational amplifier IC available in 8 pin dip and other packages. The internal circuitry of IC contains two separate operational amplifiers that can be operated with single or dual supply. There are also single and quad version of this IC which are TL071 and TL074. The single version (TL071) contains one opamp while the quad version contains four separate operational amplifiers inside due to which the package is different and it contains 14 pins.

The input stage of the TL072 contains JFET transistors which insures lower noise as compare to the BJT transistors. Both the operational amplifiers of the IC have very low current consumption and each opamp only consume 1.4mA normally.

The IC is also THD (Total Harmonic Distortion) free which is also useful if you are making any type of audio preamplifier circuit with this IC. The low noise and low harmonic capabilities with other features makes this IC ideal to use in high accuracy applications.
Replacement, Equivalent, Or Alternative ICs / Part Numbers

The equivalent ICs we are mentioning here will not be the accurate alternative of TL072 in some cases but in some applications they will work good and in some applications they will not. So it requires some experimentation to find which equivalent IC is working well. The equivalent ICs are: Ne5532, TL1971, and LM358. However, the single and quad versions of this IC also work similarly to TL072 and can be used if TL072 is not available.

The figure below shows an audio preamplifier circuit using TL072 and few other components. As mentioned above TL072 contains two separate operational amplifiers but here we have used only one operational amplifier. The operating voltage of the circuit is 9V DC.
How to Safely Long Run in a Circuit

To get long life performance with TL072 do not apply voltage more than 36V, do not drive load of more than 10mA, prevent the IC from short circuits, and always check connections before applying power to the IC. Always store in temperature above -65 degrees centigrade and below +150 degrees centigrade.

It automatically disconnects the power supply when the voltage exceeds or drops below the preset limits, preventing damage caused by overvoltage or undervoltage.

This protector continuously monitors the incoming power supply and restores the connection automatically once the voltage returns to the safe operating range. It is ideal for residential, commercial, and industrial applications where stable voltage is critical.
Over Voltage Protection: Automatically disconnects the load when voltage rises above the set limit.
Under Voltage Protection: Cuts off power when voltage falls below the safe threshold.
Adjustable Voltage Limits: User can set upper and lower voltage protection values.
Adjustable Reconnection Delay: Prevents frequent switching by adding a delay before reconnecting.
Digital LED Display: Shows real-time voltage values and device status.

Automatic Recovery: Restores power once voltage returns to normal conditions.

The device constantly measures the incoming voltage from the power supply. If the voltage goes beyond the preset upper or lower limit, the internal relay disconnects the load immediately. After the voltage returns to the normal range and the preset delay time expires, the device reconnects the power automatically.
The protector is installed between the main circuit breaker (MCB) and the load. It is designed for DIN rail mounting, making it suitable for installation inside electrical distribution panels.
